entries.example: 這不是你的錯，別責怪自己。
entries.exampleEnglish: It's not your fault. Don't blame yourself.
entries.question: 事情出錯時，你會責怪別人嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: When something goes wrong, do you blame other people?
entries.answer: 不會，我比較常責怪自己。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I tend to blame myself.

entries.example: 律師在法庭上為他辯護。
entries.exampleEnglish: The lawyer defended him in court.
entries.question: 朋友被批評時，你會幫他辯護嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: When a friend is criticised, do you defend them?
entries.answer: 會，我一定會站出來幫朋友辯護。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'll always stand up and defend my friends.

entries.example: 碗盤都放在廚房的櫥櫃裡。
entries.exampleEnglish: The bowls and plates are all in the kitchen cupboard.
entries.question: 你家廚房的櫥櫃夠用嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have enough cupboard space in your kitchen?
entries.answer: 不太夠，櫥櫃裡已經放滿了。
entries.answerEnglish: Not really. The cupboards are already full.

entries.example: 我主要在家工作。
entries.exampleEnglish: I mainly work from home.
entries.question: 你主要用什麼方法學中文？
entries.questionEnglish: What's the main way you study Chinese?
entries.answer: 我主要看台灣的連續劇。
entries.answerEnglish: I mainly watch Taiwanese TV dramas.

entries.example: 我很喜歡跳舞。
entries.exampleEnglish: I really like dancing.
entries.question: 你喜歡跳舞嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like dancing?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我週末常常去跳舞。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often go dancing on weekends.

entries.example: 把醬料和麵拌勻再吃。
entries.exampleEnglish: Mix the sauce into the noodles before eating.
entries.question: 你吃乾麵前會先拌勻嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you mix your dry noodles well before eating them?
entries.answer: 會，我都先拌勻再吃。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always mix them well first.

entries.example: 我的簽證申請核准了！
entries.exampleEnglish: My visa application has been approved!
entries.question: 你辦簽證時，等多久才核准？
entries.questionEnglish: When you applied for your visa, how long did it take to be approved?
entries.answer: 我等了兩個星期才核准。
entries.answerEnglish: I waited two weeks before it was approved.

entries.example: 他有台灣和美國雙重國籍。
entries.exampleEnglish: He has dual Taiwanese and American citizenship.
entries.question: 你想要有雙重國籍嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Would you like to have dual citizenship?
entries.answer: 想，有雙重國籍出國比較方便。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, dual citizenship makes travelling easier.

entries.example: 這瓶可樂沒氣了，不好喝。
entries.exampleEnglish: This bottle of cola has gone flat. It doesn't taste good.
entries.question: 你的腳踏車輪胎沒氣過嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Has your bike ever had a flat tyre?
entries.answer: 有，上個星期我的輪胎沒氣了。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my tyre went flat last week.

entries.example: 如果下雨，我們有替代方案嗎？
entries.exampleEnglish: If it rains, do we have a plan B?
entries.question: 計畫有變時，你會準備替代方案嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you prepare an alternative in case plans change?
entries.answer: 會，我出門旅行都會準備替代方案。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always have a plan B when I travel.

entries.english: a large stretch; a big patch
entries.example: 山上有一大片茶園。
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a large stretch of tea fields on the mountain.
entries.question: 你家附近有一大片草地嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is there a big area of grass near your home?
entries.answer: 有，河邊有一大片草地。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there's a big stretch of grass by the river.

entries.example: 他常常抱怨工作太多。
entries.exampleEnglish: He often complains that he has too much work.
entries.question: 你最常抱怨台灣的什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you complain about most in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 我最常抱怨夏天太熱。
entries.answerEnglish: I complain most about the summers being too hot.

entries.example: 我用手機轉帳給房東。
entries.exampleEnglish: I transfer money to my landlord with my phone.
entries.question: 你付房租是轉帳還是付現金？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you pay your rent by bank transfer or in cash?
entries.answer: 我都用網路銀行轉帳。
entries.answerEnglish: I always pay by online bank transfer.

entries.example: 公司下個月要舉辦尾牙。
entries.exampleEnglish: The company is holding its year-end party next month.
entries.question: 你在家舉辦過派對嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever thrown a party at home?
entries.answer: 舉辦過，去年我在家辦了生日派對。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I had a birthday party at home last year.

entries.example: 七月的台北很熱。
entries.exampleEnglish: Taipei is very hot in July.
entries.question: 你七月要做什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What are you doing in July?
entries.answer: 我七月要去日本玩。
entries.answerEnglish: I'm going on a trip to Japan in July.

entries.example: 糟糕，我忘了帶鑰匙！
entries.exampleEnglish: Oh no, I forgot my keys!
entries.question: 你遇過最糟糕的天氣是什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What's the worst weather you've ever had?
entries.answer: 最糟糕的是颱風天，又風又雨。
entries.answerEnglish: The worst was a typhoon day, with wind and rain.

entries.example: 炸雞的油脂太多了。
entries.exampleEnglish: Fried chicken has too much fat.
entries.question: 你吃東西會注意油脂嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you watch how much fat you eat?
entries.answer: 會，我盡量少吃油脂多的東西。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I try not to eat fatty food.

entries.example: 除了香菜，我什麼都吃。
entries.exampleEnglish: I eat everything except coriander.
entries.question: 除了中文，你還會說什麼語言？
entries.questionEnglish: Besides Chinese, what other languages do you speak?
entries.answer: 除了中文，我還會說法文。
entries.answerEnglish: Besides Chinese, I also speak French.

entries.example: 加州州長今天來台灣訪問。
entries.exampleEnglish: The governor of California is visiting Taiwan today.
entries.question: 你的國家有州長嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Does your country have governors?
entries.answer: 有，美國每一州都有一位州長。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, every US state has a governor.

entries.example: 大家都指責他開會遲到。
entries.exampleEnglish: Everyone criticised him for being late to the meeting.
entries.question: 你在工作上被人指責過嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever been blamed for something at work?
entries.answer: 有，主管曾經指責我報告寫得太慢。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my manager once criticised me for writing a report too slowly.

entries.example: 老闆要求我們準時上班。
entries.exampleEnglish: The boss requires us to be on time for work.
entries.question: 你的老闆對你要求很高嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Does your boss expect a lot of you?
entries.answer: 還好，他對我的要求不高。
entries.answerEnglish: Not really. He doesn't demand too much of me.

entries.example: 警察終於抓到那個罪犯了。
entries.exampleEnglish: The police finally caught that criminal.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣的罪犯多嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think there are many criminals in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 不多，我覺得台灣很安全，罪犯很少。
entries.answerEnglish: No. I think Taiwan is very safe, with few criminals.

entries.example: 這個行業的前景很好。
entries.exampleEnglish: This industry has good prospects.
entries.question: 你覺得你的工作前景好嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think your job has good prospects?
entries.answer: 不錯，我覺得這行的前景很好。
entries.answerEnglish: Pretty good. I think this line of work has a bright outlook.

entries.example: 可以轉到新聞頻道嗎？
entries.exampleEnglish: Can you switch to the news channel?
entries.question: 你最常看哪個頻道？
entries.questionEnglish: Which channel do you watch most?
entries.answer: 我最常看美食頻道。
entries.answerEnglish: I watch food channels most.

entries.example: 大家選出他當我們的代表。
entries.exampleEnglish: Everyone chose him as our representative.
entries.question: 你的國家多久選出一次總統？
entries.questionEnglish: How often does your country elect a president?
entries.answer: 我們每四年選出一次總統。
entries.answerEnglish: We elect a president every four years.

entries.example: 我每個星期都去踢足球。
entries.exampleEnglish: I go and play football every week.
entries.question: 你喜歡踢足球嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like playing football?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我週末常常去踢足球。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often play football on weekends.

entries.example: 她最近心情很脆弱。
entries.exampleEnglish: She's been feeling very fragile lately.
entries.question: 你什麼時候覺得自己比較脆弱？
entries.questionEnglish: When do you feel more vulnerable?
entries.answer: 生病又想家的時候，我比較脆弱。
entries.answerEnglish: When I'm ill and homesick, I feel more vulnerable.

entries.example: 我搭捷運去機場。
entries.exampleEnglish: I take the MRT to the airport.
entries.question: 你家離機場遠嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is your home far from the airport?
entries.answer: 不遠，坐車半個小時就到機場。
entries.answerEnglish: No, it's half an hour to the airport by car.

entries.example: 我每週固定運動三次。
entries.exampleEnglish: I exercise three times a week, regularly.
entries.question: 你有固定的運動時間嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have a regular time for exercise?
entries.answer: 有，我每天早上固定去跑步。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I go running every morning without fail.

entries.example: 這把刀很鋒利，小心手！
entries.exampleEnglish: This knife is very sharp. Watch your hands!
entries.question: 你家的菜刀鋒利嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is the kitchen knife at your place sharp?
entries.answer: 不太鋒利，該換一把新的了。
entries.answerEnglish: Not very sharp. It's time to get a new one.

entries.example: 她在公司負責財務。
entries.exampleEnglish: She's in charge of finance at the company.
entries.question: 你會自己管理財務嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you manage your own finances?
entries.answer: 會，我每個月都會整理自己的財務。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I go through my finances every month.

entries.example: 中正紀念堂看起來很宏偉。
entries.exampleEnglish: Chiang Kai-shek Memorial Hall looks very grand.
entries.question: 你看過最宏偉的建築是什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What's the most magnificent building you've seen?
entries.answer: 我覺得故宮博物院非常宏偉。
entries.answerEnglish: I think the National Palace Museum is magnificent.

entries.example: 這碗湯的味道很好。
entries.exampleEnglish: This soup tastes really good.
entries.question: 你喜歡臭豆腐的味道嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like the taste of stinky tofu?
entries.answer: 不喜歡，臭豆腐的味道太重了。
entries.answerEnglish: No, stinky tofu smells too strong.

entries.example: 醫生叫我注意飲食。
entries.exampleEnglish: The doctor told me to watch my diet.
entries.question: 你的飲食習慣健康嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are your eating habits healthy?
entries.answer: 還好，不過我的飲食有點太油。
entries.answerEnglish: They're OK, but my diet is a bit too oily.

entries.example: 這是我們兩個的秘密。
entries.exampleEnglish: This is a secret between the two of us.
entries.question: 你會跟好朋友說秘密嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you tell secrets to your good friends?
entries.answer: 會，我什麼秘密都跟她說。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I tell her all my secrets.

entries.example: 台灣的大眾運輸很方便。
entries.exampleEnglish: Public transport in Taiwan is very convenient.
entries.question: 你上班都搭大眾運輸嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you take public transport to work?
entries.answer: 對，我都搭捷運，大眾運輸很方便。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I take the MRT. Public transport is very convenient.

entries.example: 會議提前到下午兩點了。
entries.exampleEnglish: The meeting has been moved up to 2 p.m.
entries.question: 你搭飛機會提前多久到機場？
entries.questionEnglish: How early do you get to the airport when you fly?
entries.answer: 我通常提前兩個小時到。
entries.answerEnglish: I usually get there two hours early.

entries.example: 台北下雪？不太可能。
entries.exampleEnglish: Snow in Taipei? Unlikely.
entries.question: 你今年會搬去別的城市嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Will you move to another city this year?
entries.answer: 不太可能，我很喜歡現在住的地方。
entries.answerEnglish: Unlikely. I really like where I live now.

entries.example: 機場因為炸彈威脅暫時關閉。
entries.exampleEnglish: The airport was temporarily closed because of a bomb threat.
entries.question: 你喜歡看有炸彈爆炸的動作片嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like action films with bombs going off?
entries.answer: 喜歡，炸彈爆炸的場面很刺激。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, scenes with bombs exploding are exciting.

entries.example: 夜市很好玩！
entries.exampleEnglish: Night markets are so much fun!
entries.question: 台灣哪裡最好玩？
entries.questionEnglish: Where's the most fun place in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 我覺得墾丁最好玩。
entries.answerEnglish: I think Kenting is the most fun.

entries.example: 警察已經抓到嫌疑犯了。
entries.exampleEnglish: The police have already caught the suspect.
entries.question: 你喜歡看找嫌疑犯的推理劇嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like detective shows about finding the suspect?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我很喜歡猜誰是嫌疑犯。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I love guessing who the suspect is.

entries.example: 他的感冒很嚴重。
entries.exampleEnglish: His cold is very bad.
entries.question: 你住的地方塞車嚴重嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is traffic bad where you live?
entries.answer: 很嚴重，上下班時間都塞車。
entries.answerEnglish: Very bad. There are traffic jams at rush hour.

entries.example: 警察昨天逮捕了那個小偷。
entries.exampleEnglish: The police arrested the thief yesterday.
entries.question: 在你的國家，酒駕會被逮捕嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: In your country, do people get arrested for drink-driving?
entries.answer: 會，酒駕可能會被警察逮捕。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, you can be arrested for drink-driving.

entries.example: 東部的海岸非常漂亮。
entries.exampleEnglish: The east coast is beautiful.
entries.question: 你去過台灣東部的海岸嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you been to Taiwan's east coast?
entries.answer: 去過，花蓮的海岸很美。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the coast in Hualien is beautiful.

entries.example: 我十月要去日本。
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm going to Japan in October.
entries.question: 你十月有什麼計畫？
entries.questionEnglish: What are your plans for October?
entries.answer: 我十月要去花蓮玩。
entries.answerEnglish: I'm going on a trip to Hualien in October.

entries.example: 這部電影的卡司很強。
entries.exampleEnglish: This film has a strong cast.
entries.question: 你選電影時會看卡司嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you look at the cast when you choose a film?
entries.answer: 會，卡司好我就想去看。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, if the cast is good I want to see it.

entries.example: 這幾天持續下雨。
entries.exampleEnglish: It's been raining non-stop for the past few days.
entries.question: 你學中文持續多久了？
entries.questionEnglish: How long have you kept up your Chinese studies?
entries.answer: 我已經持續學了兩年了。
entries.answerEnglish: I've been studying steadily for two years.

entries.example: 請先給我們一個報價。
entries.exampleEnglish: Please give us a quote first.
entries.question: 你搬家前會先比較報價嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you compare quotes before you move house?
entries.answer: 會，我會比較三家搬家公司的報價。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I compare quotes from three moving companies.

entries.example: 開會時請把手機調成震動。
entries.exampleEnglish: Please put your phone on vibrate during the meeting.
entries.question: 你的手機平常開震動還是鈴聲？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you usually keep your phone on vibrate or ring?
entries.answer: 我的手機都開震動。
entries.answerEnglish: I always keep my phone on vibrate.

entries.example: 我在陽台種了一些種子。
entries.exampleEnglish: I planted some seeds on my balcony.
entries.question: 你想在陽台種什麼種子？
entries.questionEnglish: What seeds would you like to plant on your balcony?
entries.answer: 我想買一些番茄的種子來種。
entries.answerEnglish: I'd like to buy some tomato seeds to plant.

entries.example: 這場比賽的結果很有戲劇性。
entries.exampleEnglish: The result of this match was very dramatic.
entries.question: 你的生活有過戲劇性的改變嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Has your life ever changed dramatically?
entries.answer: 有，搬來台灣是很戲劇性的改變。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, moving to Taiwan was a dramatic change.

entries.example: 有兩個囚犯從監獄逃走了。
entries.exampleEnglish: Two prisoners escaped from the prison.
entries.question: 你看過關於囚犯的電影嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you seen any films about prisoners?
entries.answer: 看過，我很喜歡一部講囚犯逃獄的電影。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I really like a film about prisoners breaking out of jail.

entries.example: 主場的球隊比較佔優勢。
entries.exampleEnglish: The home team has the advantage.
entries.question: 你覺得會說中文找工作比較佔優勢嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think speaking Chinese gives you an advantage in finding a job?
entries.answer: 會，在台灣會說中文很佔優勢。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, in Taiwan speaking Chinese is a big advantage.

entries.example: 車票可以在網路上購買。
entries.exampleEnglish: Tickets can be bought online.
entries.question: 你常在網路上購買東西嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often buy things online?
entries.answer: 常常，我大部分東西都在網路上購買。
entries.answerEnglish: Often. I buy most things online.

entries.example: 九月還是很熱。
entries.exampleEnglish: It's still very hot in September.
entries.question: 你九月要做什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What are you doing in September?
entries.answer: 我九月要開始上中文課。
entries.answerEnglish: I'm starting Chinese classes in September.

entries.example: 很多阿姨晚上在廣場跳舞。
entries.exampleEnglish: Lots of older ladies dance in the square in the evening.
entries.question: 你家附近有廣場嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is there a square near your home?
entries.answer: 有，捷運站前面有一個廣場。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there's a square in front of the MRT station.

entries.example: 他聽到這個消息很難過。
entries.exampleEnglish: He was very sad to hear the news.
entries.question: 你什麼時候會覺得難過？
entries.questionEnglish: When do you feel sad?
entries.answer: 想家的時候，我會很難過。
entries.answerEnglish: I feel sad when I'm homesick.

entries.example: 一月的台北很冷。
entries.exampleEnglish: Taipei is cold in January.
entries.question: 你一月會回國嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are you going back to your country in January?
entries.answer: 不會，我一月要留在台灣。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I'm staying in Taiwan in January.

entries.example: 我星期日不上班。
entries.exampleEnglish: I don't work on Sundays.
entries.question: 你星期日常常做什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you usually do on Sundays?
entries.answer: 我星期日常常去爬山。
entries.answerEnglish: I often go hiking on Sundays.

entries.example: 朋友勸我少喝一點酒。
entries.exampleEnglish: My friends urged me to drink less.
entries.question: 你的家人會勸你早點回國嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Does your family urge you to come home soon?
entries.answer: 會，我媽常常勸我回家工作。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my mum often urges me to come home and work.

entries.example: 這批貨物明天會到倉庫。
entries.exampleEnglish: This batch of goods will arrive at the warehouse tomorrow.
entries.question: 你的工作需要處理貨物嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Does your job involve handling goods?
entries.answer: 需要，我每天要檢查倉庫的貨物。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I check the goods in the warehouse every day.

entries.example: 老闆，我要一碗牛肉麵。
entries.exampleEnglish: Excuse me (boss), I'd like a bowl of beef noodles.
entries.question: 你的老闆人好嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is your boss nice?
entries.answer: 很好，我的老闆很照顧我。
entries.answerEnglish: Very nice. My boss looks after me well.

entries.example: 她是電視台的記者。
entries.exampleEnglish: She's a TV reporter.
entries.question: 你想當記者嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Would you like to be a journalist?
entries.answer: 不想，記者的工作太累了。
entries.answerEnglish: No, a journalist's job is too tiring.

entries.example: 我要去超商列印文件。
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm going to the convenience store to print some documents.
entries.question: 你常在便利商店列印東西嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often print things at convenience stores?
entries.answer: 常常，我都去超商列印資料。
entries.answerEnglish: Often. I always print documents at the convenience store.

entries.example: 他決定退出這個群組。
entries.exampleEnglish: He decided to leave this group chat.
entries.question: 你退出過LINE群組嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever left a LINE group?
entries.answer: 有，太吵的群組我就退出。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I leave groups that are too noisy.

entries.example: 這家店新增了外送服務。
entries.exampleEnglish: This shop has added a delivery service.
entries.question: 你希望捷運新增哪一條線？
entries.questionEnglish: Which MRT line would you like them to add?
entries.answer: 我希望新增一條到我家的線。
entries.answerEnglish: I'd like them to add a line to my neighbourhood.

entries.example: 船長請大家穿上救生衣。
entries.exampleEnglish: The captain asked everyone to put on life jackets.
entries.question: 你小時候想當船長嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Did you want to be a ship's captain as a child?
entries.answer: 想過，我覺得當船長很酷。
entries.answerEnglish: I did. I thought being a captain was cool.

entries.example: 這件衣服很適合你。
entries.exampleEnglish: This outfit really suits you.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼工作適合你？
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of job do you think suits you?
entries.answer: 我覺得教英文很適合我。
entries.answerEnglish: I think teaching English suits me.

entries.example: 他的東西佔據了整張桌子。
entries.exampleEnglish: His things took up the whole table.
entries.question: 工作佔據你多少時間？
entries.questionEnglish: How much of your time does work take up?
entries.answer: 工作佔據了我大部分的時間。
entries.answerEnglish: Work takes up most of my time.

entries.example: 我先查一下火車時刻表。
entries.exampleEnglish: Let me check the train timetable first.
entries.question: 你搭公車前會看時刻表嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you check the timetable before taking the bus?
entries.answer: 會，我都用手機看公車時刻表。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always check the bus timetable on my phone.

entries.example: 吃不完可以打包嗎？
entries.exampleEnglish: Can we take the leftovers to go?
entries.question: 你出國前什麼時候打包行李？
entries.questionEnglish: When do you pack your luggage before a trip abroad?
entries.answer: 我都前一天晚上才打包。
entries.answerEnglish: I always pack the night before.

entries.example: 她還在等她的白馬王子。
entries.exampleEnglish: She's still waiting for her Prince Charming.
entries.question: 你小時候喜歡王子和公主的故事嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Did you like stories about princes and princesses as a child?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我最喜歡青蛙王子的故事。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my favourite was The Frog Prince.

entries.example: 我今天身體不舒服。
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm not feeling well today.
entries.question: 你不舒服的時候會去看醫生嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you go to the doctor when you feel unwell?
entries.answer: 會，不舒服我就去診所。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, when I feel unwell I go to a clinic.

entries.example: 十一月的天氣很舒服。
entries.exampleEnglish: The weather in November is very pleasant.
entries.question: 你的生日在十一月嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is your birthday in November?
entries.answer: 對，我的生日在十一月。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my birthday is in November.

entries.example: 我十二月要回家。
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm going home in December.
entries.question: 你十二月會很忙嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Will you be busy in December?
entries.answer: 會，十二月工作很多。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there's a lot of work in December.

entries.example: 這台電風扇的馬達壞了。
entries.exampleEnglish: The motor in this electric fan is broken.
entries.question: 你家的電器馬達壞過嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Has the motor in any of your appliances ever broken?
entries.answer: 壞過，洗衣機的馬達去年壞了。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the washing machine motor broke last year.

entries.example: 很多人到市政府前面抗議。
entries.exampleEnglish: Many people protested in front of City Hall.
entries.question: 你參加過抗議活動嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever taken part in a protest?
entries.answer: 沒有，我從來沒參加過抗議活動。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I've never been to a protest.

entries.example: 廚房裡都是煙，快開窗！
entries.exampleEnglish: The kitchen is full of smoke. Open the window, quick!
entries.question: 你中秋節烤肉的時候怕煙嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: When you barbecue at Moon Festival, does the smoke bother you?
entries.answer: 不怕，可是煙太大我會咳嗽。
entries.answerEnglish: No, but if there's too much smoke I cough.

entries.example: 這件事由哪個部會負責？
entries.exampleEnglish: Which ministry is responsible for this?
entries.question: 你知道台灣有哪些部會嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know which ministries Taiwan has?
entries.answer: 我知道外交部和教育部這些部會。
entries.answerEnglish: I know ministries like Foreign Affairs and Education.

entries.example: 這瓶清潔劑含有很多化學品。
entries.exampleEnglish: This bottle of cleaner contains a lot of chemicals.
entries.question: 你會避免用有化學品的清潔劑嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you avoid cleaning products with chemicals?
entries.answer: 會，我比較喜歡天然的，不用化學品。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I prefer natural ones without chemicals.

entries.example: 我和同伴一起去爬山。
entries.exampleEnglish: I went hiking with my companions.
entries.question: 你旅行時喜歡有同伴嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like having company when you travel?
entries.answer: 喜歡，有同伴比較好玩。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, it's more fun with companions.

entries.example: 他十年前創辦了這家公司。
entries.exampleEnglish: He founded this company ten years ago.
entries.question: 你想自己創辦公司嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Would you like to start your own company?
entries.answer: 想，我想創辦一家咖啡店。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'd like to open a café.

entries.example: 我八月要去旅行。
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm going travelling in August.
entries.question: 你八月放假嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have time off in August?
entries.answer: 放假，我八月休息兩個星期。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'm off for two weeks in August.

entries.example: 星期六我們去看電影吧！
entries.exampleEnglish: Let's go to the cinema on Saturday!
entries.question: 你星期六要上班嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you work on Saturdays?
entries.answer: 不用，我星期六休息。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I have Saturdays off.

entries.example: 這台電腦保固兩年。
entries.exampleEnglish: This computer has a two-year warranty.
entries.question: 你買電器會注意保固嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you pay attention to the warranty when you buy appliances?
entries.answer: 會，保固越久越好。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the longer the warranty the better.

entries.example: 在公司裡，她是我最好的盟友。
entries.exampleEnglish: At the office, she's my best ally.
entries.question: 在工作上，你有盟友嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have allies at work?
entries.answer: 有，我的主管是我最大的盟友。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my manager is my biggest ally.

entries.example: 她很會買東西，是購物女王。
entries.exampleEnglish: She's great at shopping. She's the queen of shopping.
entries.question: 你的國家以前有女王嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Has your country had a queen?
entries.answer: 有，我的國家以前有一位女王。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my country used to have a queen.

entries.example: 他用真實的事例說明這個問題。
entries.exampleEnglish: He explained the problem with real-life examples.
entries.question: 你能舉一個文化差異的事例嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Can you give an example of a cultural difference?
entries.answer: 在台灣送鐘不吉利，這就是一個事例。
entries.answerEnglish: In Taiwan, giving a clock as a gift is unlucky. That's one example.

entries.example: 我們二月要過年。
entries.exampleEnglish: We're celebrating Lunar New Year in February.
entries.question: 你二月有放假嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have time off in February?
entries.answer: 有，我二月放了一個星期。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I had a week off in February.

entries.example: 高鐵是很快速的交通工具。
entries.exampleEnglish: The high-speed rail is a very fast way to travel.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣的網路快速嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think the internet in Taiwan is fast?
entries.answer: 很快速，在家看影片都不會卡。
entries.answerEnglish: Very fast. Videos never lag at home.

entries.example: 地震以後，牆上多了一條裂縫。
entries.exampleEnglish: After the earthquake there was a new crack in the wall.
entries.question: 你家的牆上有裂縫嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are there any cracks in the walls of your home?
entries.answer: 有一條小裂縫，是地震造成的。
entries.answerEnglish: There's a small crack, caused by an earthquake.

entries.example: 這部老電影真是經典。
entries.exampleEnglish: This old film is a real classic.
entries.question: 你最喜歡哪部經典電影？
entries.questionEnglish: Which classic film do you like best?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡的經典電影是《教父》。
entries.answerEnglish: My favourite classic film is The Godfather.

entries.example: 他想找一份穩定的工作。
entries.exampleEnglish: He wants to find a stable job.
entries.question: 你的工作穩定嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is your job stable?
entries.answer: 很穩定，我在這家公司五年了。
entries.answerEnglish: Very stable. I've been with this company for five years.

entries.example: 我們在二號出口見。
entries.exampleEnglish: Let's meet at Exit 2.
entries.question: 你家附近的捷運站有幾個出口？
entries.questionEnglish: How many exits does the MRT station near your home have?
entries.answer: 那個站有四個出口。
entries.answerEnglish: That station has four exits.

entries.example: 他在尾牙抽到很大的獎品。
entries.exampleEnglish: He won a big prize in the draw at the year-end party.
entries.question: 你抽過最好的獎品是什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What's the best prize you've ever won in a draw?
entries.answer: 我抽過最好的獎品是一支手機。
entries.answerEnglish: The best prize I've won was a mobile phone.

entries.example: 因為颱風，班機延誤了。
entries.exampleEnglish: The flight was delayed because of the typhoon.
entries.question: 你搭飛機遇過班機延誤嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever had a flight delayed?
entries.answer: 遇過，有一次延誤了五個小時。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, once it was delayed for five hours.

entries.example: 我在台中有很多表親。
entries.exampleEnglish: I have lots of cousins in Taichung.
entries.question: 你有很多表親嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have many cousins?
entries.answer: 有，我的表親有二十幾個。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I have over twenty cousins.

entries.example: 他在一家音樂學院教鋼琴。
entries.exampleEnglish: He teaches piano at a music academy.
entries.question: 你大學念的是哪個學院？
entries.questionEnglish: Which college were you in at university?
entries.answer: 我念的是工學院。
entries.answerEnglish: I was in the College of Engineering.

entries.example: 前面發生車禍了。
entries.exampleEnglish: There's been a car accident up ahead.
entries.question: 你在台灣看過車禍嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you seen a traffic accident in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 看過，我看過機車的車禍。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've seen a scooter accident.

entries.example: 台灣的節慶活動很多。
entries.exampleEnglish: Taiwan has lots of festival events.
entries.question: 你最喜歡台灣的哪個節慶？
entries.questionEnglish: Which Taiwanese festival do you like best?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡的節慶是中秋節。
entries.answerEnglish: My favourite festival is the Moon Festival.

entries.example: 我預訂了週六晚上的餐廳。
entries.exampleEnglish: I've booked a restaurant for Saturday night.
entries.question: 你出去玩會先預訂飯店嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you book a hotel in advance when you travel?
entries.answer: 會，我都在網路上預訂。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always book online.

entries.example: 捷運上禁止吃東西。
entries.exampleEnglish: Eating is not allowed on the MRT.
entries.question: 你覺得捷運禁止吃東西好嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think banning eating on the MRT is a good idea?
entries.answer: 很好，禁止吃東西比較乾淨。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, banning food keeps it cleaner.

entries.example: 有人出價一百萬買這台車。
entries.exampleEnglish: Someone offered a million to buy this car.
entries.question: 你在網路拍賣上出價過嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever bid in an online auction?
entries.answer: 有，我出價買過一台舊相機。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I once bid on and bought an old camera.

entries.example: 大地震讓那棟大樓倒塌了。
entries.exampleEnglish: The big earthquake made that building collapse.
entries.question: 你擔心地震時房子倒塌嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you worry about buildings collapsing in an earthquake?
entries.answer: 有一點，我怕老房子會倒塌。
entries.answerEnglish: A bit. I'm afraid old buildings might collapse.

entries.example: 我經常在超商買午餐。
entries.exampleEnglish: I often buy lunch at the convenience store.
entries.question: 你經常運動嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you exercise often?
entries.answer: 對，我經常去公園跑步。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often go running in the park.

entries.example: 我阿姨住在高雄。
entries.exampleEnglish: My aunt lives in Kaohsiung.
entries.question: 你有幾個阿姨？
entries.questionEnglish: How many aunts do you have on your mother's side?
entries.answer: 我有兩個阿姨。
entries.answerEnglish: I have two aunts.

entries.example: 我不知道確切的時間。
entries.exampleEnglish: I don't know the exact time.
entries.question: 你知道你確切的出生時間嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know the exact time you were born?
entries.answer: 不知道確切的時間，只知道是早上。
entries.answerEnglish: I don't know the exact time, just that it was in the morning.

entries.example: 我們今晚去國家劇院看表演。
entries.exampleEnglish: We're going to the National Theater for a show tonight.
entries.question: 你多久去一次劇院？
entries.questionEnglish: How often do you go to the theater?
entries.answer: 我大概一年去劇院兩三次。
entries.answerEnglish: I go to the theater about two or three times a year.

entries.example: 這家超市賣很多進口零食。
entries.exampleEnglish: This supermarket sells lots of imported snacks.
entries.question: 你常買進口的東西嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often buy imported things?
entries.answer: 常買，我喜歡吃進口巧克力。
entries.answerEnglish: Often. I like imported chocolate.

entries.example: 這兩家公司是競爭對手。
entries.exampleEnglish: These two companies are competitors.
entries.question: 你打球時遇過很強的對手嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever played against a really strong opponent?
entries.answer: 遇過，上次的對手比我強很多。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my last opponent was much better than me.

entries.example: 星期五晚上去喝一杯吧！
entries.exampleEnglish: Let's go for a drink on Friday night!
entries.question: 你星期五晚上常做什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you usually do on Friday nights?
entries.answer: 我星期五晚上常跟朋友吃飯。
entries.answerEnglish: I often have dinner with friends on Friday nights.

entries.example: 我不喜歡星期一。
entries.exampleEnglish: I don't like Mondays.
entries.question: 你星期一早上幾點上班？
entries.questionEnglish: What time do you start work on Monday mornings?
entries.answer: 我星期一早上九點上班。
entries.answerEnglish: I start work at nine on Monday mornings.

entries.example: 她小時候想當公主。
entries.exampleEnglish: She wanted to be a princess when she was little.
entries.question: 你小時候喜歡哪個公主的故事？
entries.questionEnglish: Which princess story did you like as a child?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡白雪公主的故事。
entries.answerEnglish: I liked Snow White best.

entries.example: 星期三我要上中文課。
entries.exampleEnglish: I have Chinese class on Wednesday.
entries.question: 你星期三忙不忙？
entries.questionEnglish: Are you busy on Wednesdays?
entries.answer: 很忙，我星期三要加班。
entries.answerEnglish: Very busy. I work overtime on Wednesdays.

entries.example: 我最喜歡吃芒果。
entries.exampleEnglish: Mangoes are my favourite.
entries.question: 你最喜歡什麼台灣菜？
entries.questionEnglish: What's your favourite Taiwanese dish?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡吃牛肉麵。
entries.answerEnglish: My favourite is beef noodles.

entries.example: 星期四我要去看醫生。
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm going to the doctor on Thursday.
entries.question: 你星期四晚上有空嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are you free on Thursday evening?
entries.answer: 有空，我星期四晚上沒事。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've got nothing on Thursday evening.

entries.example: 星期二我在家工作。
entries.exampleEnglish: I work from home on Tuesdays.
entries.question: 你星期二要做什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What are you doing on Tuesday?
entries.answer: 我星期二要去游泳。
entries.answerEnglish: I'm going swimming on Tuesday.

entries.example: 這是最新的手機。
entries.exampleEnglish: This is the latest phone.
entries.question: 你用的是最新的手機嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is your phone the latest model?
entries.answer: 不是，我的手機不是最新的。
entries.answerEnglish: No, my phone isn't the latest one.

entries.example: 我對台灣歷史很感興趣。
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm very interested in Taiwanese history.
entries.question: 你對什麼最感興趣？
entries.questionEnglish: What are you most interested in?
entries.answer: 我對台灣的美食最感興趣。
entries.answerEnglish: I'm most interested in Taiwanese food.

entries.example: 天好黑，看來快下雨了。
entries.exampleEnglish: The sky is so dark. Looks like it's going to rain.
entries.question: 這個週末的天氣看來怎麼樣？
entries.questionEnglish: What does the weather look like this weekend?
entries.answer: 看來很好，我要去爬山。
entries.answerEnglish: It looks good, so I'm going hiking.

entries.example: 機場有武裝警察在巡邏。
entries.exampleEnglish: There are armed police patrolling the airport.
entries.question: 你在你的國家看過武裝警察嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you seen armed police in your country?
entries.answer: 看過，機場常常有武裝警察。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there are often armed police at the airport.

entries.example: 我知道那家店。
entries.exampleEnglish: I know that shop.
entries.question: 你知道附近哪裡有夜市嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know where there's a night market nearby?
entries.answer: 我知道，師大夜市很近。
entries.answerEnglish: I do. Shida Night Market is close.

entries.example: 她比賽得了第三名。
entries.exampleEnglish: She came third in the competition.
entries.question: 中文是你的第三種語言嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is Chinese your third language?
entries.answer: 對，中文是我的第三種語言。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, Chinese is my third language.

entries.example: 她在公司做行政工作。
entries.exampleEnglish: She does admin work at her company.
entries.question: 你的工作有很多行政的事嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Does your job involve a lot of admin?
entries.answer: 有，行政工作佔了我一半的時間。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, admin takes up half my time.

entries.example: 診所醫生把我轉介到大醫院。
entries.exampleEnglish: The clinic doctor referred me to a big hospital.
entries.question: 你看病時被醫生轉介過嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever been referred by a doctor?
entries.answer: 有，醫生把我轉介到台大醫院。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the doctor referred me to NTU Hospital.

entries.example: 美國有民主黨和共和黨。
entries.exampleEnglish: The US has the Democratic Party and the Republican Party.
entries.question: 你身邊有支持共和黨的朋友嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have friends who support the Republicans?
entries.answer: 有，我有幾個美國朋友支持共和黨。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, a few of my American friends support the Republicans.

entries.example: 台灣是一個民主的國家。
entries.exampleEnglish: Taiwan is a democratic country.
entries.question: 你覺得民主重要嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think democracy is important?
entries.answer: 很重要，我覺得民主可以保護人民。
entries.answerEnglish: Very important. I think democracy protects the people.

entries.example: 我在倫敦出生。
entries.exampleEnglish: I was born in London.
entries.question: 你在哪裡出生？
entries.questionEnglish: Where were you born?
entries.answer: 我在加拿大出生。
entries.answerEnglish: I was born in Canada.

entries.example: 在台灣，聖誕節還是要上班。
entries.exampleEnglish: In Taiwan, you still have to work on Christmas Day.
entries.question: 你聖誕節有什麼計畫？
entries.questionEnglish: What are your plans for Christmas?
entries.answer: 聖誕節我要跟朋友吃大餐。
entries.answerEnglish: I'm having a big dinner with friends at Christmas.

entries.example: 今天的工作還好，不太忙。
entries.exampleEnglish: Work was OK today, not too busy.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣的夏天熱嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you find Taiwan's summers hot?
entries.answer: 還好，我已經習慣了。
entries.answerEnglish: Not too bad. I'm used to it now.

entries.example: 他每次都投票給民主黨。
entries.exampleEnglish: He always votes for the Democrats.
entries.question: 你常看美國民主黨的新聞嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often follow news about the US Democrats?
entries.answer: 偶爾看，民主黨的新聞很多。
entries.answerEnglish: Sometimes. There's a lot of news about the Democrats.

entries.example: 我們隊今天贏了！
entries.exampleEnglish: Our team won today!
entries.question: 看比賽時，你支持哪一隊？
entries.questionEnglish: When you watch a match, which team do you support?
entries.answer: 我支持台灣隊！
entries.answerEnglish: I support Team Taiwan!

entries.example: 她很會領導團隊。
entries.exampleEnglish: She's very good at leading a team.
entries.question: 你喜歡領導別人嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like leading other people?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我在公司領導一個小團隊。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I lead a small team at work.

entries.example: 他是第四個到的。
entries.exampleEnglish: He was the fourth to arrive.
entries.question: 你是家裡第幾個孩子？
entries.questionEnglish: Where do you come among the children in your family?
entries.answer: 我是第四個孩子。
entries.answerEnglish: I'm the fourth child.

entries.example: 這位評論家很喜歡這部電影。
entries.exampleEnglish: This critic really likes the film.
entries.question: 你看電影前會看評論家的意見嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you read what critics say before seeing a film?
entries.answer: 不會，我不太相信評論家。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I don't really trust critics.

entries.example: 台灣的民主政治發展得很快。
entries.exampleEnglish: Democracy in Taiwan developed quickly.
entries.question: 你覺得民主政治有什麼缺點？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think the weaknesses of democracy are?
entries.answer: 我覺得民主政治有時候做決定很慢。
entries.answerEnglish: I think democracy is sometimes slow to make decisions.

entries.example: 我們要先評估一下成本。
entries.exampleEnglish: We need to assess the costs first.
entries.question: 你換工作前會評估什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you weigh up before changing jobs?
entries.answer: 我會評估薪水和通勤時間。
entries.answerEnglish: I weigh up the salary and the commute.

entries.example: 你的幫忙是很大的助力。
entries.exampleEnglish: Your help has been a big boost.
entries.question: 誰是你學中文最大的助力？
entries.questionEnglish: Who has helped you most with learning Chinese?
entries.answer: 我的台灣朋友是我最大的助力。
entries.answerEnglish: My Taiwanese friends have been my biggest help.

entries.example: 最新民調顯示他領先。
entries.exampleEnglish: The latest poll shows him in the lead.
entries.question: 你相信民調嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you trust opinion polls?
entries.answer: 不太相信，民調常常不準。
entries.answerEnglish: Not really. Polls are often wrong.

entries.example: 我的父母很開明。
entries.exampleEnglish: My parents are very open-minded.
entries.question: 你的父母開明嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are your parents open-minded?
entries.answer: 很開明，他們讓我自己做決定。
entries.answerEnglish: Very. They let me make my own decisions.

entries.example: 兩家公司最後和解了。
entries.exampleEnglish: The two companies settled in the end.
entries.question: 你跟朋友吵架後，會主動和解嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: After a fight with a friend, do you make the first move to make up?
entries.answer: 會，我通常會主動找他和解。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I usually go to them first to make up.

entries.example: 很多選民對政府不滿意。
entries.exampleEnglish: Many voters are unhappy with the government.
entries.question: 你在你的國家是選民嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are you a registered voter in your country?
entries.answer: 是，我是選民，每次選舉都會投票。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'm a voter and I vote in every election.

entries.example: 這台螢幕的解析度很高。
entries.exampleEnglish: This monitor has a high resolution.
entries.question: 你買手機會在意解析度嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you care about resolution when buying a phone?
entries.answer: 會，解析度高，拍照比較清楚。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, with higher resolution photos are sharper.

entries.example: 兩家公司還在談判。
entries.exampleEnglish: The two companies are still negotiating.
entries.question: 你擅長談判嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are you good at negotiating?
entries.answer: 不太擅長，我談判時會緊張。
entries.answerEnglish: Not really. I get nervous when I negotiate.

entries.example: 這條街是那隻貓的地盤。
entries.exampleEnglish: This street is that cat's territory.
entries.question: 你家的寵物有自己的地盤嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Does your pet have its own territory at home?
entries.answer: 有，沙發就是我家貓的地盤。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the sofa is my cat's territory.

entries.example: 我們隊拿到冠軍了！
entries.exampleEnglish: Our team won the championship!
entries.question: 你得過什麼冠軍嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever won first place in anything?
entries.answer: 我小時候得過游泳比賽冠軍。
entries.answerEnglish: I won a swimming competition when I was a kid.

entries.example: 她是基督徒，每個星期天都去教會。
entries.exampleEnglish: She's a Christian and goes to church every Sunday.
entries.question: 你的家人是基督徒嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is your family Christian?
entries.answer: 是，我的家人都是基督徒。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my whole family is Christian.

entries.example: 兩個國家簽了一份條約。
entries.exampleEnglish: The two countries signed a treaty.
entries.question: 你覺得國際條約重要嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think international treaties are important?
entries.answer: 重要，條約可以讓國家之間更穩定。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, treaties make relations between countries more stable.

entries.example: 他是老闆最信任的副手。
entries.exampleEnglish: He's the boss's most trusted deputy.
entries.question: 你在工作上有副手嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have a deputy at work?
entries.answer: 有，我的副手幫了我很多忙。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my deputy has helped me a lot.

entries.example: 她在銀行當分析師。
entries.exampleEnglish: She works as an analyst at a bank.
entries.question: 你想當分析師嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Would you like to be an analyst?
entries.answer: 不想，分析師的工作壓力太大了。
entries.answerEnglish: No, an analyst's job is too stressful.

entries.example: 他很有音樂才能。
entries.exampleEnglish: He has a real talent for music.
entries.question: 你覺得自己有什麼才能？
entries.questionEnglish: What talents do you think you have?
entries.answer: 我覺得我的才能是做菜。
entries.answerEnglish: I think my talent is cooking.

entries.example: 愛滋病現在可以用藥控制。
entries.exampleEnglish: AIDS can now be controlled with medication.
entries.question: 你的國家常常宣導愛滋病的知識嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Does your country often run AIDS awareness campaigns?
entries.answer: 會，政府常常宣導怎麼預防愛滋病。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the government often promotes AIDS prevention.

entries.example: 法國是一個共和國。
entries.exampleEnglish: France is a republic.
entries.question: 你的國家是共和國嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is your country a republic?
entries.answer: 是，我的國家是共和國。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my country is a republic.

entries.example: 這個新政策引起很大的爭議。
entries.exampleEnglish: This new policy has caused a lot of controversy.
entries.question: 你的國家最近有什麼爭議？
entries.questionEnglish: What's been controversial in your country lately?
entries.answer: 最近房價的問題有很多爭議。
entries.answerEnglish: Lately housing prices have been very controversial.

entries.example: 公司的發言人今天會說明。
entries.exampleEnglish: The company spokesperson will explain today.
entries.question: 你的公司有發言人嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Does your company have a spokesperson?
entries.answer: 有，我們公司有一位發言人。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, our company has a spokesperson.

entries.example: 今天是我第五天上班。
entries.exampleEnglish: Today is my fifth day at work.
entries.question: 這是你來台灣的第幾年？
entries.questionEnglish: How many years have you been in Taiwan now?
entries.answer: 這是我來台灣的第五年。
entries.answerEnglish: This is my fifth year in Taiwan.

entries.example: 我把旅行照片放進相簿。
entries.exampleEnglish: I put my travel photos in an album.
entries.question: 你的手機裡有幾個相簿？
entries.questionEnglish: How many albums do you have on your phone?
entries.answer: 我的手機裡有十幾個相簿。
entries.answerEnglish: I have more than ten albums on my phone.

entries.example: 因為通膨，便當也變貴了。
entries.exampleEnglish: Because of inflation, even lunch boxes have got more expensive.
entries.question: 通膨對你的生活有影響嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Has inflation affected your life?
entries.answer: 有，通膨讓我每個月多花很多錢。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, inflation means I spend a lot more each month.

entries.example: 雙方還在協商價格。
entries.exampleEnglish: Both sides are still negotiating the price.
entries.question: 你跟房東協商過房租嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever negotiated your rent with your landlord?
entries.answer: 協商過，房東每個月少算我一千塊。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my landlord knocked a thousand off each month.

entries.example: 這家航空公司的服務很好。
entries.exampleEnglish: This airline's service is very good.
entries.question: 你最喜歡哪家航空公司？
entries.questionEnglish: Which airline do you like best?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡台灣的航空公司，服務很好。
entries.answerEnglish: I like Taiwanese airlines best. Their service is great.

entries.example: 政府今年的預算又是赤字。
entries.exampleEnglish: The government's budget is in deficit again this year.
entries.question: 你這個月的花費有赤字嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are you in the red this month?
entries.answer: 有一點赤字，我這個月買太多東西了。
entries.answerEnglish: A bit. I bought too much this month.

entries.example: 他的故事鼓舞了很多人。
entries.exampleEnglish: His story inspired a lot of people.
entries.question: 誰的故事鼓舞過你？
entries.questionEnglish: Whose story has inspired you?
entries.answer: 我奶奶的故事一直鼓舞著我。
entries.answerEnglish: My grandmother's story has always inspired me.

entries.example: 他的想法有點激進。
entries.exampleEnglish: His ideas are a bit radical.
entries.question: 你覺得自己的想法激進嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think your views are radical?
entries.answer: 不會，我的想法一點也不激進。
entries.answerEnglish: No, my views aren't radical at all.

entries.example: 我每天用中文寫日記。
entries.exampleEnglish: I write a diary in Chinese every day.
entries.question: 你有寫日記的習慣嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you keep a diary?
entries.answer: 有，我每天晚上都寫日記。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I write in my diary every night.

entries.example: 在台灣，同性戀可以合法結婚。
entries.exampleEnglish: In Taiwan, gay couples can legally marry.
entries.question: 在你的國家，同性戀可以結婚嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Can gay couples marry in your country?
entries.answer: 可以，同性戀在我的國家可以結婚。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, gay couples can marry in my country.

entries.example: 農夫在田邊釘了一排木樁。
entries.exampleEnglish: The farmer drove a row of wooden stakes along the field.
entries.question: 你小時候看過用木樁做的圍籬嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Did you see fences made of wooden stakes as a child?
entries.answer: 看過，我爺爺的農場有很多木樁。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my grandpa's farm had lots of wooden posts.

entries.example: 很多難民需要大家的幫助。
entries.exampleEnglish: Many refugees need everyone's help.
entries.question: 你的國家接受難民嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Does your country take in refugees?
entries.answer: 接受，我的國家每年接受很多難民。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my country takes in many refugees every year.

entries.example: 新台幣是台灣的貨幣。
entries.exampleEnglish: The New Taiwan Dollar is Taiwan's currency.
entries.question: 你的國家用什麼貨幣？
entries.questionEnglish: What currency does your country use?
entries.answer: 我們用的貨幣是歐元。
entries.answerEnglish: Our currency is the euro.

entries.example: 他每個月都要繳房貸。
entries.exampleEnglish: He has to pay his mortgage every month.
entries.question: 你覺得在台北繳房貸辛苦嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think paying a mortgage in Taipei is hard?
entries.answer: 很辛苦，台北的房貸太高了。
entries.answerEnglish: Very hard. Mortgages in Taipei are too high.

entries.example: 經濟衰退讓很多人失業了。
entries.exampleEnglish: The recession left many people out of work.
entries.question: 你擔心經濟衰退嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are you worried about a recession?
entries.answer: 有點擔心，經濟衰退會影響我的工作。
entries.answerEnglish: A bit. A recession would affect my job.

entries.example: 她在大學念的是經濟學。
entries.exampleEnglish: She studied economics at university.
entries.question: 你學過經濟學嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you studied economics?
entries.answer: 學過，我大學主修經濟學。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I majored in economics at university.

entries.example: 各國領袖下週要開高峰會。
entries.exampleEnglish: World leaders are holding a summit next week.
entries.question: 你關心國際高峰會的新聞嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you follow news about international summits?
entries.answer: 不太關心，高峰會的新聞很無聊。
entries.answerEnglish: Not really. News about summits is boring.

entries.example: 他年輕的時候相信共產主義。
entries.exampleEnglish: He believed in communism when he was young.
entries.question: 你的國家有人相信共產主義嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are there people in your country who believe in communism?
entries.answer: 有，但相信共產主義的人不多。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, but not many people believe in communism.

entries.example: 這是我第六杯咖啡了！
entries.exampleEnglish: This is my sixth cup of coffee!
entries.question: 你今天喝第幾杯水了？
entries.questionEnglish: How many glasses of water have you had today?
entries.answer: 這是我今天的第六杯水。
entries.answerEnglish: This is my sixth glass of water today.

entries.example: 很多國家一起制裁那個國家。
entries.exampleEnglish: Many countries imposed sanctions on that country together.
entries.question: 你覺得經濟制裁有用嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think economic sanctions work?
entries.answer: 我覺得制裁有一點用，但不夠。
entries.answerEnglish: I think sanctions help a little, but not enough.

entries.example: 他在電影裡演一個反叛者。
entries.exampleEnglish: He plays a rebel in the film.
entries.question: 你年輕時是個反叛者嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Were you a rebel when you were young?
entries.answer: 有一點，我年輕時是個小反叛者。
entries.answerEnglish: A bit. I was a little rebel when I was young.

entries.example: 今天是第七天下雨了。
entries.exampleEnglish: Today is the seventh day of rain.
entries.question: 這是你第幾次來這家店？
entries.questionEnglish: How many times have you been to this shop?
entries.answer: 這是我第七次來這家店。
entries.answerEnglish: This is my seventh time at this shop.

entries.example: 他指稱公司沒有付他加班費。
entries.exampleEnglish: He alleges the company didn't pay him overtime.
entries.question: 你聽過有人指稱老闆欠薪水嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you heard of anyone claiming their boss owed them wages?
entries.answer: 聽過，我朋友指稱他老闆欠他三個月薪水。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, a friend claims his boss owes him three months' pay.

entries.example: 警察救出了所有的人質。
entries.exampleEnglish: The police rescued all the hostages.
entries.question: 你看過有人質的電影嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you seen a film with hostages in it?
entries.answer: 看過，那部電影最後人質都平安了。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, in the end all the hostages were safe.

entries.example: 今天是我第八天學中文。
entries.exampleEnglish: Today is my eighth day of learning Chinese.
entries.question: 你學中文第幾個月了？
entries.questionEnglish: How many months have you been learning Chinese?
entries.answer: 我學中文第八個月了。
entries.answerEnglish: This is my eighth month of learning Chinese.

entries.example: 這是我看的第九部台灣電影。
entries.exampleEnglish: This is the ninth Taiwanese film I've seen.
entries.question: 你今天是第幾個到公司的？
entries.questionEnglish: Where did you come in getting to the office today?
entries.answer: 我今天是第九個到公司的。
entries.answerEnglish: I was the ninth to arrive at the office today.

entries.example: 我們結婚第十年了。
entries.exampleEnglish: We've been married for ten years now.
entries.question: 你在台灣住第幾年了？
entries.questionEnglish: How many years have you lived in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 我在台灣住第十年了。
entries.answerEnglish: This is my tenth year living in Taiwan.

entries.example: 這條項鍊是純銀的。
entries.exampleEnglish: This necklace is sterling silver.
entries.question: 你有純銀的首飾嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have any sterling silver jewellery?
entries.answer: 有，我有一條純銀的手鍊。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I have a sterling silver bracelet.

entries.example: 這部電影有中文字幕。
entries.exampleEnglish: This film has Chinese subtitles.
entries.question: 你看台劇的時候會開字幕嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you turn on subtitles when you watch Taiwanese dramas?
entries.answer: 會，我都開中文字幕。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always turn on Chinese subtitles.

entries.example: 據說這家店的牛肉麵很好吃。
entries.exampleEnglish: They say the beef noodles at this shop are great.
entries.question: 你聽說過台灣哪裡的東西特別好吃？
entries.questionEnglish: Where in Taiwan have you heard the food is especially good?
entries.answer: 據說台南的小吃最好吃。
entries.answerEnglish: They say Tainan has the best snacks.

entries.example: 這家新公司找到了投資人。
entries.exampleEnglish: This new company has found investors.
entries.question: 你想當投資人嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Would you like to be an investor?
entries.answer: 想，我想當咖啡店的投資人。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'd like to invest in a café.

entries.example: 這個App的製作者是台灣人。
entries.exampleEnglish: The maker of this app is Taiwanese.
entries.question: 你知道你最喜歡的遊戲的製作者是誰嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know who made your favourite game?
entries.answer: 知道，那個遊戲的製作者是日本人。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the maker of that game is Japanese.

entries.example: 他是穆斯林，所以不吃豬肉。
entries.exampleEnglish: He's Muslim, so he doesn't eat pork.
entries.question: 你身邊有穆斯林朋友嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have any Muslim friends?
entries.answer: 有，我有幾個穆斯林同事。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I have a few Muslim colleagues.

entries.example: 我在網路上看到這篇報導。
entries.exampleEnglish: I saw this report online.
entries.question: 你最近看了什麼有趣的報導？
entries.questionEnglish: What interesting news reports have you read lately?
entries.answer: 我看了一篇關於夜市的報導。
entries.answerEnglish: I read a report about night markets.

entries.example: 他是大家公認最好的廚師。
entries.exampleEnglish: He's widely recognised as the best chef.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼是台灣公認最好吃的小吃？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think is widely seen as Taiwan's tastiest snack?
entries.answer: 我覺得牛肉麵是大家公認最好吃的。
entries.answerEnglish: I think beef noodles are generally agreed to be the best.

entries.example: 這部電影有很強的民族主義。
entries.exampleEnglish: This film has strong nationalist overtones.
entries.question: 你覺得你的國家民族主義強嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is nationalism strong in your country?
entries.answer: 不太強，我們很少談民族主義。
entries.answerEnglish: Not very. We rarely talk about nationalism.

entries.example: 冰箱裡的牛奶沒有了。
entries.exampleEnglish: The milk in the fridge is all gone.
entries.question: 你冰箱裡的雞蛋還有嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you still have eggs in your fridge?
entries.answer: 沒有了，我等一下要去買。
entries.answerEnglish: No, they're all gone. I'm going to buy some later.

entries.example: 這台機車要換零件了。
entries.exampleEnglish: This scooter needs some parts replaced.
entries.question: 你自己換過腳踏車的零件嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever replaced bike parts yourself?
entries.answer: 換過，我自己換過一些小零件。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've replaced some small parts myself.

entries.example: 廁所在右邊。
entries.exampleEnglish: The toilet is on the right.
entries.question: 你的座位右邊坐誰？
entries.questionEnglish: Who sits to the right of you?
entries.answer: 我右邊坐我的同事。
entries.answerEnglish: My colleague sits to my right.

entries.example: 我住在台北。
entries.exampleEnglish: I live in Taipei.
entries.question: 你住在哪裡？
entries.questionEnglish: Where do you live?
entries.answer: 我住在新北市。
entries.answerEnglish: I live in New Taipei City.

entries.english: line up into; form (a line or shape)
entries.example: 請大家排成一排。
entries.exampleEnglish: Everyone, please line up in a row.
entries.question: 你在台灣看過大家排成長長的隊嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you seen people form long queues in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 看過，買雞排的人排成一條長龍。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, people lined up in a huge queue for fried chicken.

entries.example: 這支手錶是我爸送的。
entries.exampleEnglish: My dad gave me this watch.
entries.question: 你每天都戴手錶嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you wear a watch every day?
entries.answer: 對，我每天都戴手錶。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I wear a watch every day.

entries.example: 他頭腦很好，學東西很快。
entries.exampleEnglish: He's very smart and learns things quickly.
entries.question: 你什麼時候頭腦最清楚？
entries.questionEnglish: When is your mind clearest?
entries.answer: 早上喝完咖啡，我的頭腦最清楚。
entries.answerEnglish: My mind is clearest in the morning after coffee.

entries.example: 我只是輕微感冒，不用擔心。
entries.exampleEnglish: I've only got a mild cold. Don't worry.
entries.question: 你在台灣感覺過輕微的地震嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you felt minor earthquakes in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 感覺過，這裡常常有輕微的地震。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there are often small earthquakes here.

entries.example: 我確定他明天會來。
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm sure he'll come tomorrow.
entries.question: 你確定明年還住在台灣嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are you sure you'll still live in Taiwan next year?
entries.answer: 確定，我明年還會住在台灣。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'm sure. I'll still be in Taiwan next year.

entries.example: 他說謊，他根本沒在加班。
entries.exampleEnglish: He lied. He wasn't working overtime at all.
entries.question: 你小時候常常說謊嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Did you often lie when you were a child?
entries.answer: 不常，我小時候很少說謊。
entries.answerEnglish: Not often. I rarely lied as a child.

entries.example: 這家超商現在有買一送一的優惠。
entries.exampleEnglish: This convenience store has a buy-one-get-one-free deal right now.
entries.question: 你買東西會等優惠嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you wait for deals before buying things?
entries.answer: 會，我常等週年慶的優惠。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often wait for the anniversary sale deals.
